info.title: Recorded Future Playbook Alerts
info.description:
A Recorded Future API for Playbook Alerts.

The playbook alert API provides programmatic access to Recorded Future playbook alerts.
These alerts differ quite a bit from the standard "alerts" generated by Recorded Future, 
in that they include additional lookups and information that further empower the user to make accurate and timely decisions. 
Information presented in a playbook alert will also be updated as needed, 
based on new information or changes in the Recorded Future risk scores based on elapsed time or similar.

The API has several generic endpoint, categorized as common, intended as entry points into Playbook Alert data.
Most notably there is /search for finding alerts, and resource item endpoints for previewing basic alert data (`GET /common/{id}`),
and updating an alert (`PUT /common/{id}`).

For more detailed information and evidence there are a set of endpoint for each alert category.
These produce datasets grouped into panels, ready to be rendered as UI elements.

Please read the [detailed support article](https://support.recordedfuture.com/hc/en-us/articles/6934348280851-Playbook-Alert-API) before using this API.

entity.description: Entity of the alert (ID). For Domain Abuse alerts the entity is the attacker domain and for Vulnerability Alerts the entity is the CVE.

assignee.description: Return Playbook Alerts with this assignee. Valid assignees can be listed in /metadata/assignees. If omitted or empty, no filtering will be done on assignee.

organisation.description: Return Playbook Alerts with either of the organisations as owner.  If omitted or empty, no filtering will be done on organisations.

info.title: Recorded Future Playbook Alerts
info.description:
A Recorded Future API for Playbook Alerts.

The playbook alert API provides programmatic access to Recorded Future playbook alerts.
These alerts differ quite a bit from the standard "alerts" generated by Recorded Future, 
in that they include additional lookups and information that further empower the user to make accurate and timely decisions. 
Information presented in a playbook alert will also be updated as needed, 
based on new information or changes in the Recorded Future risk scores based on elapsed time or similar.

The API has several generic endpoint, categorized as common, intended as entry points into Playbook Alert data.
Most notably there is /search for finding alerts, and resource item endpoints for previewing basic alert data (`GET /common/{id}`),
and updating an alert (`PUT /common/{id}`).

For more detailed information and evidence there are a set of endpoint for each alert category.
These produce datasets grouped into panels, ready to be rendered as UI elements.

Please read the [detailed support article](https://support.recordedfuture.com/hc/en-us/articles/6934348280851-Playbook-Alert-API) before using this API.

info.title: Recorded Future Playbook Alerts
info.description:
A Recorded Future API for Playbook Alerts.

The playbook alert API provides programmatic access to Recorded Future playbook alerts.
These alerts differ quite a bit from the standard "alerts" generated by Recorded Future, 
in that they include additional lookups and information that further empower the user to make accurate and timely decisions. 
Information presented in a playbook alert will also be updated as needed, 
based on new information or changes in the Recorded Future risk scores based on elapsed time or similar.

The API has several generic endpoint, categorized as common, intended as entry points into Playbook Alert data.
Most notably there is /search for finding alerts, and resource item endpoints for previewing basic alert data (`GET /common/{id}`),
and updating an alert (`PUT /common/{id}`).

For more detailed information and evidence there are a set of endpoint for each alert category.
These produce datasets grouped into panels, ready to be rendered as UI elements.

Please read the [detailed support article](https://support.recordedfuture.com/hc/en-us/articles/6934348280851-Playbook-Alert-API) before using this API.

info.title: Recorded Future Playbook Alerts
info.description:
A Recorded Future API for Playbook Alerts.

The playbook alert API provides programmatic access to Recorded Future playbook alerts.
These alerts differ quite a bit from the standard "alerts" generated by Recorded Future, 
in that they include additional lookups and information that further empower the user to make accurate and timely decisions. 
Information presented in a playbook alert will also be updated as needed, 
based on new information or changes in the Recorded Future risk scores based on elapsed time or similar.

The API has several generic endpoint, categorized as common, intended as entry points into Playbook Alert data.
Most notably there is /search for finding alerts, and resource item endpoints for previewing basic alert data (`GET /common/{id}`),
and updating an alert (`PUT /common/{id}`).

For more detailed information and evidence there are a set of endpoint for each alert category.
These produce datasets grouped into panels, ready to be rendered as UI elements.

Please read the [detailed support article](https://support.recordedfuture.com/hc/en-us/articles/6934348280851-Playbook-Alert-API) before using this API.
